title: Hamilton January3 Hugs Over Masks gathering
notes: The Canadian Press reports a police estimate of 40 at the January 3 gathering. January 10's 60 is a separate observation; the counts are not summed. Recurrence link to E017 awaits the original unit rule.

title: Quebec City first-night curfew protest
notes: The QMI report estimates about 20. Police intercepted the group and arrested those refusing identification. Those arrests are not assigned to Montreal.

title: Saint-Georges first-night curfew protest
notes: The local report estimates 30–40; the group left the Georgesville parking lot before curfew. Police explicitly reported no arrests. E014's multicity announcement adds no participants.

title: Peterborough January23 anti-lockdown protest
notes: Police estimate 15–18 present. Ten other people were prevented from joining and are not added to attendance. The report mentions the same group on January 16 without giving that day's attendance.

title: Moncton January24 restriction protest
notes: The inquiry reports about 25. Global's January 26 report describes six arrests; the later inquiry describes three, citing a January 28 report. The response discrepancy is retained and does not establish attendance.

title: Hamilton Canadian-arms-export blockade
notes: Approximately 30 blocked trucks. The demand targeted Canadian arms-export policy toward Saudi Arabia, so it meets the domestic-policy target criterion in principle. Police explicitly reported no arrests. Attendance determines exclusion.

title: Surrey planned solidarity protest for Indian farmers
notes: The report describes a planned solidarity action stopped by the RCMP. Its demand concerned India's farm laws. An executed gathering of 50 is also unverified.

title: Vancouver Indian-consulate farmer solidarity
notes: CIVICUS indexes roughly 100 outside the Indian consulate opposing Indian farm laws. No Canadian policy demand is identified. The original report remains a follow-up; the secondary index does not create independent corroboration.

title: Vancouver January6 Trump/restriction protest
notes: The report estimates about 24. Canadian restriction messages mean a foreign-target-only label would be inaccurate. No evidence of 50 attendees.

title: Toronto January6 Trump-support convoy
notes: Support for the US election claim; more than a dozen vehicles is not a person count. No Canadian policy demand is verified.

title: Calgary January6 Trump-support gathering
notes: The reporter estimates 30–40. No explicit Canadian policy demand is verified; generic freedom placards do not establish it.

title: Mary River blockade discovery with conflicting month
notes: The opened company account dates the blockade start to February 4. A May secondary search snippet calls it January; that conflict is preserved. More than 700 affected workers are not protesters. Route the lead to Canada February 2021.

title: New Brunswick ACORN virtual tenant protest
notes: The organizer's retrospective describes nearly 40 people online. The first physical Moncton action was February 26, with 20 people. Neither establishes a January physical gathering of 50.

title: Braided Warriors Vancouver insurance-office sit-in
notes: The opened UBCIC statement dates the sit-in to February 19. Its January reference concerns a UN letter. February allegations about police response are not assigned to January.

title: Alberta musicians' coal-policy opposition
notes: The contemporary Canadian Press roundup describes social-media statements, with no physical gathering of 50. Its publication date is not an observed protest date.
